GRAMMAR
Tick (✓) A, B, or C to complete the sentences.

Example:  I love _____ the guitar.

A  play
B  played
C  playing  ✓
1 Jenny doesn’t like _____ TV.

A  watches
B  watching
C  watch

2 I’m going ______ at a hotel near the beach.

A  staying
B  stay
C  to stay

3 She likes _____ dinner for all her friends.

A  makes
B  making
C  make

4 Where _____ to live?

A  you are going
B  are you going

C  you going

5 It’s going _____ tomorrow.

A  to be sunny
B  be sunny
C  to sunny

6 Do you _____?

A  driving like
B  like drive
C  like driving

7 A  Are you going to cycle to France?

B  No, _____.

A  I’m not going
B  I’m not

C  I’m not cycle

8 _____ to rain?

A  It is going
B  Is going
C  Is it going

9 John loves _____.

A  read
B  books
C  reads

10 Sue _____ to play football on Wednesday.

A  is going not
B  not going
C  isn’t going
11 _____ to study English at university.

A  He go
B  He going
C  He’s going

12 My brother doesn’t like _____ in the sea.

A  go swimming
B  swimming
C  swim
13 What are _____ do?

A  they going to
B  going to
C  they go to
14 _____ going to watch the film.

A  She not is
B  Not she is
C  She isn’t

15 I like _____ exercise.

A  do
B  doing
C  I do

16 It’s going _____ next week.

A  to hot
B  be cold
C  to snow

17 She’s going _____ a marathon in June.

A  run
B  to run
C  running

18 ______ to ski?

A  Going she
B  She goes
C  Is she going
19 What time are _____ to Paris?

A  going to get
B  we going get

C  we going to get

20 What music do you _____?

A  like play
B  like playing
C  like plays

VOCABULARY

Example:  My sister loves _____ shoes.

A  buying  ✓    B  shopping

C  paying

A  watching
B  going
C  having

2 My dad loves _____ in the garden. He grows flowers
and vegetables.

A  doing
B  making
C  working

3 I like _____ art exhibitions at the weekend.

A  going to
B  travelling
C  painting

4 Amy likes _____ online with her friends on her new
computer.

A  playing
B  meeting
C  chatting

5 I like _____ the piano.

A  playing
B  doing
C  listening

b Tick (✓) the word or phrase that goes with the bold
verb A, B, or C.

Example:  go  A an email
B  to work  ✓
